text: Ratio adjustments are the DAOIC's key tool for strategic increases in profitability and overall policy, and they should be subject to a member vote conducted through the decentralized reputation staking governance mechanisms.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

isBasedOn.name: Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance

abstract: Ratio adjustments provide a key tool for strategic increases in profitability and overall DAOIC policy. Ratio adjustments should be subject to DAOIC member vote following the decentralized reputation staking governance mechanisms (Calcaterra & Kaal et al (2019)).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: governance metrics subject to dynamic upgrade over the DAOIC life cycle
